ev.q: CDC conducted an opt-in Internet panel survey of 3,618 U.S. HCP
Coverage was higher among HCP who reported an employer requirement for influenza vaccination (96.8%) than among those who reported an employer recommendation (76.5%)
Overall, 89.9% of HCP reported having received ≥1 dose of a COVID-19 vaccine
Overall, 79.9% of HCP reported having received an influenza vaccination during the 2021–22 season
Coverage was higher among HCP who reported an employer requirement for influenza vaccination (96.8%) than among those who reported an employer recommendation (76.5%)
Compared with the 2020–21 influenza season, increases in influenza vaccination coverage were observed
An Internet panel survey of HCP was conducted during March 29–April 19, 2022
Compared with the 2020–21 influenza season, increases in influenza vaccination coverage were observed

methods_quotes.q: The Korn-Graubard method was used to calculate CIs for proportions, assuming that the weighted estimates were approximately unbiased.
T-tests were used to assess differences among subgroups; p<0.05 was considered statistically significant.
A poststratification weight for each survey respondent was calculated by fitting a generalized exponential model
CDC’s National Center for Health Statistics reliability criteria for proportions were applied to the estimates in the descriptive analyses
